source.title: The Tolman-Eichenbaum Machine: Unifying Space and Relational Memory through Generalization in the Hippocampal Formation

confidence_rationale: High source quality (Cell, extensively cited, confirmed against real place/grid cell remapping data) and strong conceptual mapping fidelity to SD-004's claim that hippocampal action-object structure is a general-purpose relational backbone, not a spatial-only one. Confidence held below 0.85 because TEM's 'relations' are graph edges over a single learned transition structure (spatial/associative adjacency), not yet a labeled multi-relation-type topology (requires/enables/conflicts-with/etc.) -- it evidences the SUBSTRATE CAPACITY, not the specific relation-typing this thought proposes.
failure_signatures: TEM's entorhinal 'structural knowledge' basis is learned as a single abstract relational code per task structure; the paper does not model or require an agent to hold multiple qualitatively distinct relation TYPES (e.g. requires vs. conflicts-with) simultaneously over the same possibility set -- so it under-determines whether one general topology or several parallel task-specific ones is the more faithful reading of the biology.

Structural transfer is demonstrated for tasks the model has already been trained to represent (e.g. re-mapped spatial environments, non-spatial transitive-inference-like tasks); the paper does not test online discovery/revision of the relational structure DURING goal pursuit, which is the discovery-through-action claim this thought's Section 8 formulation depends on.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Medial entorhinal cells form a basis describing structural (relational) knowledge, independent of sensory content; hippocampal cells bind this structural basis to sensory/task-specific content. After training, this single mechanism reproduces grid, place, border, and object-vector cell properties AND generalizes to non-spatial relational tasks, with structural knowledge preserved (not randomly reset) across hippocampal remapping between environments.
mapping.ree_translation: Directly supports SD-004's premise that the hippocampal map backbone is a general relational/structural code, not a spatial-navigation-specific one -- i.e. the same kind of substrate the thought intake proposes could hold a general topology of possibilities (parent/subgoal, requires, enables, etc.) rather than only goal-subgoal paths. TEM's preserved structural knowledge across remapping is the closest existing empirical analog to 'context imposes a relevance field over a larger stored topology' (Section 4 of the intake): the structure persists and is re-used, only its sensory binding changes with context.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This paper was gathered specifically to evaluate the NOT-YET-REGISTERED candidate claim (a general relational-possibility topology with multiple explicit relation types, discovered/revised through action). TEM supports the underlying biological/computational PLAUSIBILITY of a general-purpose relational substrate beyond parent/subgoal, but it models one homogeneous relational structure per task rather than a typed multi-relation graph (requires/enables/conflicts-with/etc.), and it does not test structure-revision during active goal pursuit. So it is evidence FOR the substrate SD-004 already claims, and evidence that such a substrate COULD in principle generalize the way the candidate claim needs -- but it does not itself establish the typed-relation or in-action-revision parts of the candidate claim, which remain the open, testable residue.
mapping.source_context: Computational model (deep learning + Hopfield-network hippocampal readout) validated against rodent electrophysiology (place cells, grid cells, remapping) and human/rodent behavioral non-spatial relational-inference tasks; cross-species/task generalization claims are the paper's central contribution, not a side note.

confidence_components.notes: source_quality high (flagship venue, since-replicated architecture, direct comparison to real unit recordings). mapping_fidelity moderate: strong on 'hippocampus generalizes relational structure beyond space' (SD-004's core claim), weaker on the specific typed-multi-relation and in-action-discovery extensions this intake is evaluating. transfer_risk moderate: model-to-biology transfer is already partially validated in the paper itself (real unit data), but model-to-REE-architecture transfer (V3 substrate) is untested.
